physicalNotes: Temperature 9540 +/- 100 K and radius 1.50 +/- 0.01 solar radii from the fit to the star's spectral energy distribution by Stolker et al. GM from the 2.2 solar masses the tracks give for its temperature (their Appendix A), the mass their orbit fit adopts, times the JPL solar GM.
